continuity: Seong Jinho secretly rode inside Taekyung's capsule and reached Taekyung's new family home without being detected.
Kim Jong-su, Jinho's college classmate, absconded with Jinho's five-million-won housing deposit, leaving Jinho unable to afford his goshiwon rent.
Taekyung offered Jinho a place in the Guild-provided officetel while the family house is remodeled.
Taekyung remains officially registered in the modern world as a C-rank Hunter belonging to Hope Guild.

A radio report stated that an F-rank Gate in Uldae-ri, Jangheung-myeon, Yangju City had caused six casualties; after stabilization, Hunters and the military reported exterminating fifty-eight goblins and began searching for survivors.
A crumpled car was launched through the air toward Taekyung's taxi.
plot: After logging out of the Murim, Taekyung awakens in his new home to a feast of ramen prepared by Seong Jinho. Jinho reveals that he secretly hid inside Taekyung's capsule after his college friend Kim Jong-su absconded with his five-million-won housing deposit. Taekyung refuses to let Jinho stay in the family house while it is being remodeled, instead arranging for them to live together in the Guild-provided officetel.

During Taekyung's mid-September taxi commute, a radio reports an F-rank Gate in Yangju City that has caused six casualties and released goblins. Taekyung then hears a crash, uses his enhanced senses, and realizes that a crumpled car is flying toward his taxi.

active_continuity: One Step Back grants Taekyung two level-ups and 20 Bonus Points.

Taekyung's Heavenly Martial Physique absorbed the elixirs' energy and expelled substantial turbid qi.
Jeok successfully opened Taekyung's Conception and Governor Vessels; Taekyung completed the related Quest and regained consciousness after seven days and nights.
Opening the Conception and Governor Vessels greatly improved Taekyung's perception, qi handling, and internal-energy circulation.
Jeok considers Taekyung's mental strength exceptional and believes the Heavenly Martial Physique chose its master well.
